strategies.desc: Performs 8 dependent all-reduce operations sequentially, where each iteration computes data-dependent factors from the previous result, applies them, all-reduces, then normalizes. This is the reference implementation with 8 all-reduce dispatches (one initial + 7 iterative). Trades maximum dispatch count for simplest correctness guarantee.

strategies.name: Fused factor computation with vectorized operations
strategies.desc: Maintains the 8 sequential all-reduce structure but fuses all 8 block-factor computations into a single vectorized operation per iteration, eliminating intermediate buffers and loops. Still 8 all-reduce dispatches but reduces local computation overhead through tensor operations instead of Python loops. Optimizes compute density without changing communication pattern.

strategies.name: Pipelined reduce-scatter then all-gather chain
strategies.desc: Decomposes each all-reduce into reduce-scatter followed by all-gather to enable overlapping communication with the data-dependent factor computation on partial results. Uses 16 collective dispatches (8 RS + 8 AG) but allows factor computation to proceed on scattered chunks while next RS is in flight. Trades dispatch count for latency hiding through pipeline parallelism.

strategies.name: Block-parallel all-reduce with late synchronization
strategies.desc: Recognizes that the 8 blocks are independent within each iteration and issues 8 smaller all-reduce operations in parallel (or batched) per iteration, computing factors independently per block. Requires 64 total all-reduce dispatches (8 blocks × 8 iterations) but each operates on 512 elements instead of 4096. Trades message count for smaller per-message latency and potential batch coalescing.

strategies.name: Logarithmic recursive doubling with factor broadcasting
strategies.desc:
Replaces flat all-reduce with a recursive-doubling tree pattern (log₂(224) ≈ 8 stages) where each rank exchanges partial results and factors with peers, computing updated factors at each tree level. Approximately 8×8=64 point-to-point exchanges replacing 8 all-reduces. Trades collective simplicity for reduced algorithmic communication volume in large world-size regimes.
